meta_description:
119K likes, 76 comments - isushanthreddy on September 7, 2026: "Happy Birthday to the one who keeps life life-ing always exciting and happening! ❤️

You’re doing an amazing job managing life and, most importantly, a mother. Watching you be a mom has honestly been one of my favourite things. 

Thank you for taking care of us, standing strong, and always pushing me to stay grounded, learn and try new things.

And of course… it’s your birthday, but you still pushed me for a morning safari because you’ve already done it before and I shouldn’t miss it! 😂

That’s just you. ❤️

Happy Birthday, Janu! 🥂".
